# meraki_disconnect_appliance_umbrella_account (Action)

This action can invoke the `Disconnect Appliance Umbrella Account` operation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "meraki_disconnect_appliance_umbrella_account" "example" {
  config {
    network_id = "N_24329156"
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_id` (String) Network ID
